OPERATOR SCOPING DIRECTIVE (verbatim, 2026-10-09 and 2026-10-10; it governs how findings are weighed): "We are not chasing perfection, but a functioning system." and "98/98 is not perfection, it is functional." The 98/98 bar is unchanged and is never lowered. A finding is material when it would leave the operator approving an architecture or plan that drops or contradicts a settled requirement or an operator directive, specifies a unit, policy, process, component, entity, DTO, endpoint, error code, acceptance criterion, or diagram inconsistently or not at all, misstates live code, a probe receipt, or a store record it cites, cannot be executed under its own gates and rules, deadlocks two rules, or misstates evidence. Wording polish and style are not findings.

OPERATOR DIRECTIVES FOR THIS EFFORT (verbatim, in order; the settled HV requirements S-01 to S-33 and standing rules P-01 to P-07 are quoted in amendment section 3 with their sources, which you verify):
- 2026-10-16, the task: "Finish the handoff at ~/github/McpServer/docs/handoffs/hv-architecture-amendment-handoff-20261016T182551Z.md (untracked in the main checkout; read it from there, do not modify the main checkout). MANDATORY ATTACK SURFACES (every one, scored separately): (1) every claim below and every implementer claim in the documents and commits (counts, SHAs, receipts, store reads, line citations); (2) workspace rules (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, the marker, the profile): honesty, receipts, MCP-only TODO, session-log, and requirement storage, PowerShell only, no Python, no Node, no secrets, no tables, no en or em dashes, UTC timestamps in data and sortable local timestamps for display (D-08), signed commits, no force push; (3) requirements: FR, TR, TEST, AC, UC, and mappings for this proposed work, each AC with a named test, each in a phase where its dependencies exist; (4) the plan holistically: PLAN-HVPIPELINE-001's phases, gates, discipline, definition of done, open decisions, and the problems it pulls in, against amendment section 20 and the operator's four-phase structure.

OUT OF SCOPE (do not score): the implementation (none exists and none is authorized: code freeze); the federation plan and the foundation plan beyond what the amendment cites from them; pull request 81's merge itself; the implementer's earlier conduct. The implementer and all of its statements are UNTRUSTED, including its pre-HV self-review record /home/sharpninja/github/McpServer/.claude/worktrees/hv-amendment-20261016/docs/receipts/hv/20261017T091907-amendment1-r1.selfreview.md. Verify against the files, git history, the live sources under src, plugins/core, and tests at develop 36783b79 (this branch's base), the probe receipts under /home/sharpninja/.claude/receipts/McpServer/20261016T153600-hv-amendment-vi-probes/, the Cline session file the amendment cites, pull request 81 on GitHub (read only, `gh`), and the live MCP store (read only).

CLAIMS TO ATTACK (each PASS | FAIL | UNKNOWN with evidence):
AM1. Settled requirements: S-01 to S-33 and P-01 to P-07 are carried verbatim from their cited sources, none weakened, contradicted, or missing; D-01, D-02, D-05, and D-06 are settled correctly from the operator's instructions with the sources named; D-04, D-07, and D-08 record the operator's answers faithfully and are applied everywhere they bear (D-07 in section 20.4 and both TODOs; D-08 in section 12 and every time-bearing identifier); D-03 is correctly left with the operator.
AM2. Definitions and consistency: every unit of work is exactly one CQRS command or query with its handler and one complete activity diagram (nested diagrams directly after their use); every policy, process, shared component (each defined once, DRY), entity, DTO, route and alias, MCP tool, client method, REPL verb, Director command, plugin verb, and error code is defined once and stated identically everywhere; sequences cover every externally callable request and every response; use cases cover UC-HV-01 to UC-HV-12; Addendum B shows the relationships; namespaces say where a thing goes and names say what it is.
AM3. Durability: crash windows W-01 to W-12 each recover as stated; invariants I-01 to I-13 hold and are proved by named acceptance criteria; leases, fences, the atomic finalization, the transactional outbox, and at-least-once execution are sound, and nothing claims exactly-once; no two rules deadlock (for example P-02's absence of a time limit against process cleanup, FR-MCP-HVPIPE-008-AC011).
AM4. Live output (S-22, P8): the design delivers each reviewer line while the reviewer runs, and FR-MCP-HVPIPE-008-AC003 discriminates it.
AM5. Audit and retention (S-29, I-13): every HV write has its ledger rows, an audit failure is a hard stop, evidence is retained until an explicit removal, and the audit ledger is append-only and never purged.
AM6. Reviewer facts: VI-01 to VI-08 and section 16.3 match the probe receipts and the installed CLIs (read their --help and versions; launch no review or probe of another agent).
AM7. Foundation amendments A-01 to A-12: each names the clause it replaces, the replacement is consistent with the foundation at 36783b79 (SHA-256 claimed in the amendment's first paragraph) and with the HV design, and together they are exactly the clauses that assume a manual HV with one configured grader.
AM8. Requirements: the 63 records and 21 mappings exist in the store and equal section 19.1 field by field (title, description, every acceptance criterion's id and text); all 114 acceptance criteria name a test; every mapping edge is backed by a TEST statement; each criterion can be proven in the phase of section 20.1 that owns it.
AM9. Problems: P1 to P15 each match the cited source lines and receipts at this branch; REMED-HVPIPELINE-001 equals section 21; section 20.4's assignment of P1 to P15 to the plan's phases (D-07 for P10 to P15) is phase-consistent, and each fix follows its owning plan's approved design; for P10 to P15, the six findings match the Codex review of pull request 81 (posted after the merge), and the stated contradictions of two Codex remedies with approved decisions (the federation plan's D5; the foundation's FR-MCP-SESSIONTURN-005, created by that plan, not yet in the store) are accurate.
AM10. Plan holistically: PLAN-HVPIPELINE-001 derives from section 20 without contradiction or extension; the BDPv4 order (requirements, interfaces and stubs, TDD with mocks and a green mock gate, then implementation by bounded context) is kept; status NOT APPROVED, code freeze, and the HV of the plan's own work by the operator-named reviewer are stated; nothing instructs code before approval.
AM11. Process rulings: GitHub Actions and Azure Pipelines are no gate, requirement, or evidence; every build and test runs through Nuke; Octopus only for releases; every designed script or tool is PowerShell (no Node, bash, bats, or Python); integration and live checks run on a separate temporary instance, never the live server.
AM12. Hygiene: SPDX header; no en or em dash and no table in the amendment; no secret in the amendment, the commits under review, or the two TODOs; each commit of this effort is signed per the marker's Commit Signing rule; every push was fast-forward with no force.

For every FAIL and UNKNOWN give: the location (file and line, or record id), the exact defect, the evidence, and the specific change that would make it PASS, and classify it as an implementer edit or an operator decision (name the decision and its options).

OPERATING RULES FOR YOU: review only. No edits, commits, pushes, deletions, or changes to triage, memories, settings, TODOs, requirements, or session-log turns other than your own. Any script you write is PowerShell (pwsh -NoProfile -NonInteractive), checked with the PowerShell parser and Invoke-ScriptAnalyzer before it runs against data; bash only to launch pwsh; no Python. Write receipts only under docs/receipts/hv/ in this worktree.

The ETA is your own estimate and never a bound on review time.

RECEIPTS (mandatory): write docs/receipts/hv/hostile-validator-amendment1-r1-20261017T091907.md (the complete verdict prose) and .json (built from native PowerShell objects with ConvertTo-Json, never handwritten). Include: TimestampUtc and TimestampLocal (D-08: UTC in data, local for display), ValidatorIdentity with live model and effort proof, the add-profile file count, marker read confirmation, each claim with evidence, the commands you ran with their exit codes, OverallVerdict, Accuracy, Completeness, Confidence, the FAIL and UNKNOWN lists, the implementer-fix versus operator-decision classification, and your sessionId and requestId.
